summary: Productivity is broadly functional on all three devices, but four P1 problems stand out. (1) KOS.ui.menu panels sit at --z-menu 110, under the modal layer at 120, so any menu inside a dialog is invisible and can't be clicked. This is why the Afternoon review's 'Place in a free block' does nothing, and About to Study's 'Change' is broken the same way. (2) KOS.show assigns state.ui.view only after rendering, so every page header paints the previous page's band after in-app navigation. (3) About to Study ignores the Focus page's 'General study — no link' choice and links the session to the first assignment, even through 'Just start'. Time is then banked on the wrong assignment. (4) The running Focus screen has no width cap on the assignment chip, so long titles run off the viewport. Calendar has no Agenda or Day view on Mac/iPad: Agenda only exists in the phone branch of render(). The rest is polish: dead space (Routines offer card, the Reminders inspector, the Focus page while minimised, the routine Today columns), touch targets under 44px (Pacing ticks and day selects, Reminders circles, routine pick boxes drawn as 22x44 capsules), the review time strip's overlapping labels, and wording (repeated streak notes, raw ISO due dates).
coverage: Seeded and empty accounts. Mac 1470x832, iPad 820x1180 and 1180x820 (touch), iPhone 402x874. A DOM measurement sweep ran over #/focus, #/reminders, #/routines (today, routines, templates, history, settings, edit/habits), #/calendar and #/pacing (week and braid) at mac/ipad/iphone, seeded and empty. Screenshots I looked at: Focus idle, About to Study, running stage, break, mini player (Mac), phone dock, switch dialog, completion review (Mac and iPhone); Reminders All and Today with 'From your plan' and the empty state; Routines Today offer, routine card, list, editor, player (Mac and iPhone), history, settings; Calendar Month (Mac, iPad landscape), Week (Mac, iPad portrait), phone Agenda/Month; Pacing week (Mac, iPhone) and braid; Daily Review afternoon (Mac, iPad) and evening. The 'Place in a free block' bug was reproduced and root-caused by measurement and a programmatic click. Not examined: the idle watch end to end (30-minute timers; code not traced), the Stopwatch, Custom and Study-until modes running, the Morning review's 'pick three' step, the Templates detail and the routine editor's step '⋯' menu, the habit editor with real habits (the seed has none), Reminders' edit inspector, sub-tasks and recurrence editor, the Calendar event modal, the Pacing edit-week and class-days dialogs, the Dawn theme and a shop theme (no time left), and the iPad Home Screen standalone mode.

findings.title: Afternoon review: 'Place in a free block' menu opens BEHIND the review dialog, so it does nothing
findings.detail: Daily Review > Afternoon > step 3 Time left. Pressing 'Place in a free block' sets aria-expanded=true and appends the menu panel to <body>, but the panel is z-index var(--z-menu)=110 while the review overlay is var(--z-modal)=120, so the menu is painted under the dialog's scrim and panel: nothing visible appears, and a tap where the item would be lands on the dialog (elementFromPoint at the first item's centre returns another row's 'Place in a free block' button). The item's onSelect itself works: invoking it programmatically creates the study block (15:30, 90 min, type study, assignmentId 1) with an Undo toast. Same root cause affects EVERY KOS.ui.menu used inside a KOS.ui.openDialog (the primitive never raises a menu above an open modal). Also reproduced on About to Study's 'Change ▾' task menu (preflight dialog): panel z=110, elementFromPoint at its first item returns the dialog's k-field, not the menu.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/dr-place-open-mac.png (menu open per aria-expanded, nothing shown); eval: panel z=110, overlay z=120, panel parent BODY, topEl at item centre = 'k-btn k-btn--sm ui.menu-button'; css/tokens.css:1031-1032 (--z-menu:110, --z-modal:120); css/components.css:334 (.k-menu-panel z-index var(--z-menu)); js/core/ui.js:813 (place() appends panel to document.body); js/modules/dayreview.js:609
findings.fix: In KOS.ui.menu place(): when the button is inside an open dialog (btn.closest('[data-ui~="ui.dialog"], .k-dialog-overlay')), append the panel inside that overlay (or set a state the CSS maps to z-index above --z-modal, e.g. a --z-menu-modal token 130). Add a smoke test that opens a menu inside openDialog and checks elementFromPoint hits the item.
findings.rootCause: Menu layer token (110) below the modal layer token (120); menus are portalled to body regardless of an open modal.

findings.title: Every page header shows the PREVIOUS page's painted band after in-app navigation
findings.detail: KOS.ui.pageHeader picks its art from KOS.store.state.ui.view, but KOS.show sets state.ui.view only AFTER the view function has rendered. So navigating Pacing -> Routines draws Pacing's band on Routines, Routines -> Focus draws Reminders' band (Routines maps to 'reminders') on the Focus Timer, Focus -> Reminders draws none (Focus has no PAGE_ART entry), etc. Only a reload (where ui.view was persisted) shows the right picture. Repro via eval navigating #/pacing,#/routines,#/focus,#/reminders,#/calendar,#/routines: header images were reminders, pacing, reminders, none, none, calendar respectively. Affects every page that uses pageHeader, not only Productivity; the art audit just released depends on it.
findings.evidence: eval output: '#/pacing [app.hero.page.reminders.webp]', '#/routines [app.hero.page.pacing.webp]', '#/focus [app.hero.page.reminders.webp]', '#/routines [app.hero.page.calendar.webp]'; shots/productivity/focus-mac-seed.png and routines-mac-seed-2.png (sticky-note pinboard band on Focus/Routines); js/core/ui.js:589-592 (art = PAGE_ART[state.ui.view]); js/core/ui.js:1541-1543 (view rendered, then ui.view assigned)
findings.fix: Set a module variable (e.g. KOS.ui.currentView = viewId) BEFORE calling KOS.views[viewId] and read that in pageHeader; or have each view pass opts.art explicitly. Add a smoke check: navigate A->B and assert B's band id.
findings.rootCause: Ordering: state.ui.view is assigned after render in KOS.show (js/core/ui.js:1543), while pageHeader reads it during render.

findings.title: Focus: 'General study — no link' is overridden by About to Study, which silently links the session to the first assignment (even with 'Just start')
findings.detail: On #/focus with subject 'General study — no link' and 'No assignment', pressing Start focus opens About to Study pre-filled with the overdue NEA assignment. Pressing 'Just start' (or Start Focus) starts a session with subject 'compsci' and assignmentId 1. The completed session then banks its minutes on that assignment (invariant 4a) and counts as CS study, i.e. time is misattributed. The only escape in the dialog, 'Change ▾', is a KOS.ui.menu that opens behind the dialog (same z-index bug), so there is no way to keep 'no link' short of turning off About to Study.
findings.evidence: eval: Focus page left on General study/no assignment -> Start focus -> preflight.just-start -> session {subject:'compsci', assignmentId:1}; shots/productivity/focus-running-mac.png (About to Study shows NEA); js/modules/routineplayer.js:279-287 (taskOf falls back to taskChoices()[0] when ctx has no subject/assignment), 257 (go(skip) merges task even when skip); js/modules/focus.js:2253
findings.fix: taskOf(ctx) must respect an explicit 'no link' from the Focus page: pass ctx.explicit = true from focus.js and return {title:'General study'} without falling back; offer the ladder's suggestion as a 'Use: <task>' choice instead of a default. 'Just start' should start exactly the Focus page's config (ctx without task). Fix the menu z-index too.
findings.rootCause: taskOf() treats an empty subject as 'nothing chosen' and fills it from Today's three/assignments; go(true) still merges the filled task.

findings.title: Running Focus: a long assignment title runs off the screen (left edge on Mac, right edge on iPhone)
findings.detail: The objective/context column on the running Focus screen holds the assignment chip ('課 <title>') with no max width, wrapping or ellipsis. With the NEA assignment the k-fx-ctx box is 616px wide: on the Mac it starts at x=-131 (text cut at the window's left edge: 'tion: stakeholder interviews…'), on iPhone it ends at x=648 in a 402px viewport. The due date is printed raw ('due 2026-10-29'), as are the Focus page's assignment options ('· due 2026-10-29'). On iPhone the context card is also washed out over the bright window art (chips barely legible).
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/focus-running-mac.png (left edge), shots/productivity/focus-running-iphone.png; eval: .k-fx-ctx rect x=-131..485 (mac), 32..648 (iphone, vw 402); js/modules/focus.js:879-883 (chip('課 '+asg.title), chip('due '+asg.due)), 1018, 2175; css/views/productivity.css:113-114
findings.fix: Give .k-fx-ctx max-inline-size:100% (min-inline-size:0 on the column) and the chip a max-inline-size with text-overflow:ellipsis (title attr for the full name); format due with KOS.ui/hub dayLabel ('due Thu 29 Oct', 'overdue 4 d'). On phone put the context card on a stronger scrim (var(--s1) at ~80%).
findings.rootCause: Chips are nowrap and the flex column is aligned to the end with no width cap, so long content overflows to the left (end-aligned) or right.

findings.title: Afternoon review time strip: end label '22:00 夜' overprints the last hour tick; 30-minute block text wraps to two lines
findings.detail: In the Time left strip the hour ticks are left-anchored at their position and run up to the last hour before the evening review, while the end label is pinned at inline-end. With from=04:46 and until=22:00 the 21:00 tick starts at ~94% of the width, exactly under '22:00 夜' (the screenshot shows '2̶2̶:̶0̶0̶' overprinted). Short free blocks (30 min = ~31px) wrap '30 min' onto two lines and overflow their outline. Same overlap happens at any width; worse on iPad portrait and phone where the strip is narrower.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/dr-afternoon-timeleft-mac.png (top-right of strip, and the 08:00 block); js/modules/dayreview.js:593-604 (tick loop t<to; tend appended unconditionally); css/views/routines.css:340-341; shots/productivity/dr-afternoon-ipad-empty.png (iPad portrait: ticks 20:00/22:00 and '22:00 夜' overprinted, '30 mi' clipped)
findings.fix: Skip any tick whose position is within ~1 label width (e.g. >88%) of the end label, or render the end label as the final tick; thin ticks by available width (every 2h/3h below ~700px). For blocks narrower than the label, show the length only in the aria/tooltip or as a single-line '30m' with white-space:nowrap and no padding.
findings.rootCause: No collision handling between left-anchored ticks and an inline-end end label; fixed hourly tick density regardless of width.

findings.title: Calendar has no Agenda (or Day) view on Mac or iPad; Agenda exists only under 700px
findings.detail: At >700px the Calendar offers only Month and Week (js/modules/calendar.js:1545 mode is 'week'|'month'; buttons at 1589-1591). The Agenda list (renderPhone, the stored 'week' mode) is drawn only when matchMedia('(max-width:700px)') matches (calendar.js:1562-1563, 1613). So the user cannot get the agenda on the MacBook (1470) or iPad (820/1180). There is no Day view at any size. Also the same stored value calMode='week' means 'Week grid' on desktop and 'Agenda' on phone, so an iPad in Split View flipping across 700px silently changes view type.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/cal-week-mac.png, cal-week-ipad.png, cal-month-ipadl.png (segmented control: Month | Week only); shots/productivity/calendar-iphone-seed.png (Agenda | Month); js/modules/calendar.js:1545,1562-1563,1589-1591,1613-1620
findings.fix: Make the mode a 3-value per-device setting {month, week, agenda} (+ optional day). Factor the phone agenda list (renderPhone's day lists + agendaRows) into a renderAgenda(board) usable at any width: on desktop/iPad draw it as the board beside the existing Today/Countdowns side column (a 2-week scrolling list grouped by day with time column, hue bar, derived chips). Keep phone default Agenda; migrate stored 'week' on phone to 'agenda'.
findings.rootCause: Agenda was designed as the phone composition (frame 15g) and is hard-wired to the phone branch of render().

findings.title: iPad portrait Calendar: '+ New event' wraps to its own row leaving a full-width empty band
findings.detail: At 820px the header row (‹ title › Today Show Month|Week) fills the width and '+ New event' drops alone to a second line at the left, leaving ~600px empty beside it and pushing the grid down ~60px.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/cal-week-ipad.png (y≈235)
findings.fix: Below 1080 put Today/Show on a second toolbar row with New event at its end, or collapse '+ New event' to the '+' icon button used on phone; or let the title shrink (clamp font-size) so the row fits.
findings.rootCause: .k-cal-head is a wrapping flex row with no layout tier between desktop and phone.

findings.title: Routine offer checkboxes render as 22x44 tall pills on touch devices
findings.detail: In 'Start with these?' (Routines Today/Routines/Templates tabs) each pick box (.k-rt-check, routine.offer-pick) keeps its 22px width while the coarse-pointer rule raises its height to 44px, so on iPad and iPhone each checkbox is a white 22x44 capsule instead of a square. Invariant 69: a control raised for touch must raise its width too.
findings.evidence: measure: 'SMALL button.k-rt-check[routine.offer-pick] 22x44' on ipad and iphone; shots/productivity/routines-iphone-seed.png (tall white capsules)
findings.fix: Give .k-rt-check an explicit aspect-ratio:1 / inline-size equal to block-size under (pointer:coarse), or keep the visual 22px box and grow the hit area with the whole row as the label (the row is already a button-like card).
findings.rootCause: Global coarse-pointer min-block-size for buttons without a matching min-inline-size on this control.

findings.title: Routines 'Start with these?' card leaves ~400px dead on the right on Mac
findings.detail: The offer card spans the full content width (1210px) but the illustration + a ~560px text/list column use only the left two thirds; the right ~400px is empty. Violates the no-dead-space rule.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/routines-mac-seed-2.png
findings.fix: Either cap the card's width and place a second card beside it (e.g. Today's reviews), or lay the three template picks out as three columns across the width (they are short), or move the illustration to the right edge so the text sits between.

findings.title: Reminders: the right inspector column is a small hint card over a dead column
findings.detail: With nothing selected, the 320px right column holds only 'Select a reminder to edit…' (120px tall) and is empty below for the whole list length.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/reminders-mac-seed.png, rem-today-mac.png
findings.fix: When nothing is selected, collapse the inspector and let the list widen, or fill it with useful context (Today's count, upcoming this week, 'From your plan' summary, quick-add with date).

findings.title: Reminders 'Today' leaves out overdue reminders
findings.detail: Today shows 2 items while 8 reminders are overdue; they are only under Overdue/All. A user working from Today never sees what slipped. Most reminder apps (Apple Reminders) show overdue at the top of Today. Also 'From your plan' rows each carry a '↻ From your plan' chip under a 'FROM YOUR PLAN' heading (redundant), and the 'Open plan' links and priority chips sit on different right edges (≈1082 vs ≈1056).
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/rem-today-mac.png; js/modules/reminders.js:334-349
findings.fix: Include overdue items in Today under an 'Overdue' group (count it in the Today badge or show '2 + 8 overdue'); drop the per-row chip in the plan group; align the trailing column.

findings.title: Focus page while a session is minimised is one banner over an empty page
findings.detail: With a session running and minimised, #/focus shows only 'Session in progress — Computer Science' and 'Return to the stage →'; the rest of the 1210x500 content area is blank (Your record, The deal, today's sessions all disappear). Dead space and a lost chance to show live context (objective, cycle progress, notes, today's total).
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/focus-page-minimised-mac.png
findings.fix: Keep the idle page's right column (Your record with today's live total, The deal with the running session's live award preview from KOS.governor.focusAward) and in place of the setup card show a compact live card: clock, cycle bar, objective, Switch…, notes, End early/Return to the stage.

findings.title: Pacing week: lesson ticks (18x18) and lesson-day selects (62x24) are far below the 44px touch minimum on iPad/iPhone
findings.detail: Every class lesson row's tick input (.k-pace-tick-in) measures 18x18 and its day <select> (pace.lesson-day) 62x24 at 820px and 402px with a coarse pointer; the week strip's scroller arrows are 32x32. On the iPad (the user's study device) these are the main controls of the page.
findings.evidence: measure prod/m-ipad-__pacing.json, m-iphone-__pacing.json: 'SMALL input.k-pace-tick-in 18x18', 'SMALL select.k-pace-lesson-day 62x24', 'SMALL button.k-scroller-arrow 32x32'; shots/productivity/pace-week-iphone.png
findings.fix: Make the whole lesson row a <label> for its tick (hit area = row height ≥44) and raise the day select to min-block-size 44px under (pointer:coarse) (or use the dense 24px-with-spacing exception explicitly, invariant 69).

findings.title: Daily Review marks sit in the Week view's all-day row and their time is truncated away
findings.detail: Review marks carry a time (Morning review · 07:00 etc.) but Week view lists them in the all-day row, where the 115px column truncates them to 'Morning revie…', so the time never shows; they also push every day's all-day row to 5-6 lines, shrinking the timed grid.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/cal-week-mac.png (all-day rows 5-6 chips tall); eval: 21 review chips at y 297-401; js/modules/calendar.js:600-606, 1799-1801
findings.fix: Draw timed derived marks (reviews, routine windows) as thin dashed markers in the timed grid at their time, or as one compact '朝 昼 夜' glyph row per day with the times in the tooltip/aria.

findings.title: Routines: page-header 'Templates' button duplicates the Templates tab 60px below
findings.detail: The page header's actions are 'Templates' and '+ New routine', and the tab strip right under it has a Templates tab going to the same place. Invariant 50b: never offer the same destination twice in-page.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/routines-mac-seed.png; js/modules/routines.js (routine.templates button)
findings.fix: Drop the header 'Templates' button (keep + New routine), or drop the Templates tab and keep the button.

findings.title: Daily habits card repeats the page sub-line, truncated, and has no add button when empty
findings.detail: Routines Today: the Daily habits card heading's sub-line 'a habit is a routine with one …' is the page header's sub-line again and is ellipsised; empty it shows a paragraph and only a small 'Add habits ›' text link at top-right (on iPhone the link overlaps the truncated sub-line per measurement). Card height then leaves a dead lower half.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/routines-mac-seed-2.png (Daily habits card); measure iphone: 'OVERLAP span.k-rt-hd-m.k-ellipsis x button.k-link[routine.habits-edit]'; measure mac DEADH routine.habit-card used 95/244
findings.fix: Remove the sub-line (or make it unique, e.g. 'tick-only, auto-tracked'), and in the empty state put a primary '+ Add a habit' button in the body.

findings.title: Session review repeats '36-day streak' four times and hides what the bonus gold was for
findings.detail: Ending a Pomodoro paid +59 gold (5 for the session + 3+7+14+30 streak milestone bonuses that had not been recorded). The review and the toast print the note list '36-day streak · 36-day streak · 36-day streak · 36-day streak' and a single '+59 gold' while The deal had promised +5 gold, so the user cannot tell why. Each milestone pushes the CURRENT streak length as its note instead of the milestone it paid. The toast also sits over the review's 'Save review' button on Mac.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/focus-review-mac.png, focus-review-iphone.png; eval KOS.governor.lastAward() = {gold:59, notes:['36-day streak'×4]}; js/core/governor.js:330-338 (notes.push(stk + '-day streak'))
findings.fix: Push one note per milestone: ms + '-day streak bonus +' + ms + ' gold' (or merge into one: 'Streak bonuses 3·7·14·30 days +54 gold'); show the session's own award and bonuses as separate lines in the review. Keep toasts above the dialog footer (offset by the footer height when a dialog is open).

findings.title: Reminders: complete circles are 32x32 on touch
findings.detail: The round complete button (rem.check) stays 32x32 with a coarse pointer on iPad and iPhone (invariant 69 asks 44 for coarse pointer, raising width with height for a circle). The sort/priority pill selects are 30px tall on iPad.
findings.evidence: measure m-ipad-__reminders.json / m-iphone-__reminders.json: 'SMALL button.k-rem-check 32x32' (×28), 'SMALL select.k-pill-select 161x30'
findings.fix: Under (pointer:coarse) give .k-rem-check a 44x44 hit box (visual circle can stay 22-24px via an inner span) and the pill selects min-block-size 44px.

findings.title: Daily Review step tabs: the active tab's focus ring is clipped to two vertical crimson bars
findings.detail: After a step tab is clicked, its focus outline renders only as two vertical crimson lines at its left and right (top and bottom are clipped by the step strip's overflow), which reads as a rendering glitch rather than a focus ring. Seen on Mac and iPad, in Afternoon and Evening reviews.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/dr-afternoon-timeleft-mac.png (around 'Time left'), dr-afternoon-ipad-empty.png, dr-evening1-mac.png (around 'Tomorrow')
findings.fix: Use :focus-visible only (no ring after a pointer click) and an inset ring (outline-offset negative or box-shadow inset) so the scroller's overflow cannot clip it.

findings.title: Evening review: 'Tomorrow's first task' says nothing is due while overdue plan rows exist; lesson rows show bare dashes
findings.detail: In the evening review the first-task card reads 'Nothing is due soon, so tomorrow starts wherever you like.' although the afternoon review and Reminders list overdue carried-over plan rows; the candidates leave out Pacing rows. The card is then a tall empty box beside the timetable. Tomorrow's lessons with no class time print '–' in the time column.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/dr-evening1-mac.png; js/modules/dayreview.js:585 (empty-candidates text)
findings.fix: Feed carried-over plan rows (KOS.pacing.dueThisWeek().carried) and the Focus ladder's next into the candidates; omit the time cell (or show 'lesson') when a lesson has no time.

findings.title: Running Focus in a break: red 'End early' stays in the header beside 'End session'
findings.detail: Once a Pomodoro cycle is banked, the stage shows '✓ End session' (pays +35 XP…) but the header still offers a red 'End early', so there are two end controls with conflicting wording and colour.
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/focus-stage-break-mac.png
findings.fix: Hide 'End early' (or relabel it 'End' in neutral style) when canComplete() is true.

findings.title: Routines Today: three equal columns stretch the reviews and habits cards to the routine card's height
findings.detail: With a routine due, Today's reviews (3 rows, ~200px of content) and Daily habits (one paragraph) are stretched to the Morning Routine card's ~460px, leaving large empty lower halves; the routine card's header is cramped ('Leave by 07:45 / 163 min from now' wraps to 4 lines while the side cards are empty).
findings.evidence: shots/productivity/rt-today-mac.png
findings.fix: Give the routine card 2 of 3 columns (or a full row) and stack reviews + habits in the third column; align-items:start for the side cards.

qol: Daily Review Time left: after placing a block, mark the row 'Placed 15:30' (and remove that free block) so the same item isn't placed twice.
Week view: open on the first event or 07:00 when 'now' is outside working hours, instead of centring on 05:00.
Focus mini player (Mac): show the subject or objective beside the clock; the tiny progress ring next to the time is barely readable.
Routine player (Mac): it has both an ✕ and a 'Close' in the side panel; keep one.
Reminders: a 'Place in a free block' / 'Focus on this' action on a reminder, to tie Reminders to Focus and the Calendar.
Calendar: stored events with unknown types (e.g. 'other' from imports or the seeder) render with no hue at all; run the stored events through KOS.calendar.normalise once at boot.
backlog: Routines inside routines: a step can reference another routine. Model: add step.sub = <routineId> in normaliseStep (js/core/routines.js:142). Display text and minutes are DERIVED from the sub-routine (mins = the sum of its required steps' mins), never copied. Integrity, enforced in normalise(rec, base) and in the editor: (a) no cycles: walk sub links depth-first from the routine being saved, refusing any step whose sub reaches the parent (also cap depth at 2, so a sub-routine cannot itself contain subs); (b) the sub-routine's total cannot exceed the parent step's budget. Either make the step's mins read-only (= sub total), or, if the user sets a budget, refuse a save of the sub that would push it over and say which parent step it breaks; (c) a sub-routine must be on demand or share the parent's days (kind/anchor), otherwise it would also show on its own schedule. Keep 'days: null' (on demand) as the rule for anything used as a sub; (d) deleting a routine used as a sub is refused, or offers to unlink (steps become plain text with the last derived minutes). Logging: ticking a sub step in the player expands the sub's steps inline, and the parent step counts done when the sub's own completion rule is met that routine day. The sub's log entry is written under its own key with a parent tag, so it pays nothing on its own (pay once per invariant 143: only the parent pays). snapOf must store the sub's id and its frozen step list in the parent's snapshot (x[6] = sub snapshot), so editing the sub never rewrites a past day. The cloud merge needs no change (steps merge whole with the routine). Player: a nested progress bar, 'Shower · from Morning hygiene (3 steps)'.
Calendar Agenda view for Mac and iPad: a 2-week scrolling day list beside the Today/Countdowns column, sharing the phone's agendaRows.
Focus page while running: a live in-page session card (clock, cycles, objective, notes, Switch) in place of the empty banner.
Unify KOS.ui.menu layering: a single top-layer root (or native popover API) that every menu, picker and toast uses above modals.
